operator_question: Can we safely and defensibly fly this mission?

status_legend.pass: Modeled margin is outside the warning band.
status_legend.warning: Modeled margin is positive but close enough to require operator review.
status_legend.fail: Modeled margin is negative; modify the mission before release.
status_legend.unknown: ORBITAL does not have enough data to classify this group.

regulatory_metadata.ground_risk_population_note: Utility corridor inspection over mixed industrial and lightly populated roadside areas; operator should review site-specific ground risk before dispatch.
regulatory_metadata.approving_authority_source: Operator-provided example authority source for documentation-only demo
special_conditions_limitations: Remain within the modeled utility corridor and geofence buffers.
Do not launch if current field weather is below operator minimums.
operating_assumptions: Pilot-in-command verifies current FAA, local, site, NOTAM, TFR, and airspace requirements before launch.
Mission remains within the modeled route, altitude, weather, battery, geofence, and crew constraints.
Visual observer staffing and crew communications are confirmed before dispatch.
unresolved_items: Confirm utility owner site-access approval for the planned inspection window.
Confirm launch and recovery area permissions with the local site contact.
regulatory_metadata.documentation_only_notice: For planning documentation only. ORBITAL does not provide LAANC, waivers, authorizations, legal approval, or operational clearance.
regulatory_metadata.decision_support_disclaimer: ORBITAL provides decision support only and is not legal approval. This report does not provide LAANC, waivers, authorizations, operational clearance, legal advice, or permission to fly. The pilot-in-command and operator remain responsible for all required regulatory review, approvals, and compliance decisions.

top_limiting_constraint.label: Wind / weather margin
top_limiting_constraint.status_meaning: Modeled margin is outside the warning band.
top_limiting_constraint.plain_english: Checks whether modeled or forecast wind stays below the configured safe operating limit.
top_limiting_constraint.why_this_matters_to_operator: Wind reduces endurance, increases tracking error, and can turn a feasible route into a recovery or containment problem.
top_limiting_constraint.recommendation: Wait for better wind or lower mission scope.
top_limiting_constraint.recommended_operator_action: Confirm launch-time weather against operator minimums and keep the forecast source with the mission package.

top_three_risk_drivers.label: Battery reserve margin
top_three_risk_drivers.status_meaning: Modeled margin is outside the warning band.
top_three_risk_drivers.plain_english: Checks whether the planned sortie lands with the operator-required battery reserve still available.
top_three_risk_drivers.why_this_matters_to_operator: A BVLOS inspection needs enough remaining energy for delay, diversion, recovery, and conservative abort decisions.
top_three_risk_drivers.recommendation: Reduce route length or plan a relaunch / battery swap.
top_three_risk_drivers.recommended_operator_action: Keep the reserve assumption, confirm launch battery state, and brief abort reserve before dispatch.

top_three_risk_drivers.label: Route completion status
top_three_risk_drivers.status_meaning: Modeled margin is outside the warning band.
top_three_risk_drivers.plain_english: Checks whether the candidate plan reaches all required inspection points.
top_three_risk_drivers.why_this_matters_to_operator: Incomplete route coverage can waste a crew deployment and create pressure to improvise in the field.
top_three_risk_drivers.recommendation: Split the inspection into shorter sorties.
top_three_risk_drivers.recommended_operator_action: Confirm the waypoint list matches the inspection scope and brief any acceptable skipped-point policy.

constraint_groups.label: Geofence / no-fly-zone clearance
constraint_groups.status_meaning: Modeled margin is outside the warning band.
constraint_groups.plain_english: Checks whether the route remains outside no-fly zones and preserves the configured stand-off buffer.
constraint_groups.why_this_matters_to_operator: Geofence clearance protects people, assets, restricted areas, and customer boundaries when navigation or wind uncertainty appears.
constraint_groups.recommendation: Adjust route geometry or increase no-fly-zone clearance.
constraint_groups.recommended_operator_action: Keep the geofence file and route review in the evidence bundle, then confirm site boundaries before flight.

constraint_groups.label: Turn / bank feasibility
constraint_groups.status_meaning: Modeled margin is outside the warning band.
constraint_groups.plain_english: Checks whether planned turns stay within configured bank-angle and turn-rate capability.
constraint_groups.why_this_matters_to_operator: Overly aggressive turns can break route tracking, increase energy use, and reduce safety margins near assets or geofences.
constraint_groups.recommendation: Lower cruise speed or add more turn spacing.
constraint_groups.recommended_operator_action: Keep the planned speed and turn assumptions, then verify they match the aircraft operating envelope.
